ache.title: Col is limited, and so is your patience
ache.note: This guide covers Col, a limited unit on the destined banners, plus her exclusive skin and a mini battle pass. That’s three asks stacked on one character: pull before she leaves, buy the look, buy the pass. “Snipe her” sounds clever, but it’s still a pull made under a clock.
watch: a limited unit with a ticking banner
a mini battle pass tied to her
ache.tip: If one character comes with three ways to pay, pick none and see how you feel next week.
lines: one character, three price tags. sus
“snipe” is just pulling with a cool name

videoData.title: Character Starter Guides: Col | Sword of Convallaria

textData.text: Join me as I dive into the details of the limited unit Col, one of the standout characters in Sword of Convallaria. I'll cover everything from her availability in the destined banners, her unique traits and skills, to her rank tree and in-game performance. Whether you're aiming to snipe her in the banners or just interested in her gameplay mechanics, this comprehensive guide has you covered. Plus, I'll showcase her incredible combat abilities in a live demo, highlighting her assassination and survival techniques. Don't miss out on tips for maximizing her potential and information on her exclusive skin and mini battle pass.
